name: BuildFlow Procure-to-Pay Shadow Audit
problem: A business needs to reconstruct purchasing flow, approval state, receipts and invoice references without turning a new product into the authoritative general ledger.
intent_terms: our invoices do not match receipts
audit purchase approvals without replacing accounting
reconstruct request to purchase order to invoice
our vendor invoices and purchase orders keep disagreeing
inputs: Authenticated vendors, purchase requests, approvals, purchase-order references, receipts and invoice references.
outputs: Process timeline, approval gaps, invoice/receipt exceptions, recommendations and reconciliation context.
pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: Current BuildFlow mode is shadow-first. It does not post accounting entries, create external POs or initiate payment.
invocation_status: SOURCE-VERIFIED: discovery, tenant-scoped P2P model and bounded internal approval-request flow are implemented and build-tested; external client canary remains pending. External writes disabled.
